title: Monsanto chemicals sprayed in Vietnam cause birth defects
summary: Brigham Buhler tells of Monsanto chemicals sprayed in Vietnam cause birth defects, about Vietnam War era at Vietnam, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: the chemicals that Monsanto was using. They started shipping over to like Vietnam and third world countries that didn't have the regulatory guidelines and oversight and spraying crops with all these chemicals that then started creating birth defects.

plain: Brigham Buhler, a guest on podcast host Jesse Michels' show about drug companies and human experiments, says that Monsanto, a large American chemical company, shipped its chemicals to Vietnam and to poorer countries that had few safety rules. According to Buhler, the chemicals were sprayed on crops there and then began causing birth defects. He tells it as an example of companies harming people where no one was watching.
